scope: Two fixed-palette offline asset samples only. No map/UI/runtime integration.
api_signature: (image_path, out_path, colormode=None, hierarchical=None, mode=None, filter_speckle=None, color_precision=None, layer_difference=None, corner_threshold=None, length_threshold=None, max_iterations=None, splice_threshold=None, path_precision=None)
quantization: Visible-pixel MEDIANCUT training; fixed 24/48 RGB palettes; no dithering; input source alpha retained; final fills snapped to the same palette.
simplification: Supported v0.6.15 spline fitting and 10px subdivision threshold, 1 decimal path precision. No v1.0 CLI-only simplify parameter or post-fit simplifier claimed.
transparency: No opaque background or embedded image. Trace has transparent exterior; PNG antialiased edge alpha is represented by vector coverage, not a per-pixel alpha map.

visual_assessment: 두 후보는 고목 줄기·뿌리·암반의 중간 형태를 수작업 도형 시안보다 원화에 가깝게 남긴다. 24색은 명암 경계와 색 뭉침이 더 두드러지고 48색은 돌과 흙의 색 분리가 조금 낫지만, 둘 다 수관·흙의 잔질감을 많은 경로로 보존하며 일부 부유 조각도 남는다.
decision: BOTH UNSUITABLE for deployment or integration: 3.4–3.5 MB raw, ~1.1 MB gzip, ~3k paths and ~129k cubic segments. No further combinations, no map/UI/master changes, no art completion claim.
